title: The Quiet Battlefield
text: An old battlefield, very still. A sword stands upright in the middle of it with a ring of clean ground round it, and a voice on the wind asks who fought best of you.

options.label: The one with most kills steps up.

outcomes.text: The sword comes free in their hand, and the wind sighs.

options.label: The one who has saved most lives steps up.

outcomes.text: The sword stays put. The wind says this was the right answer anyway.
The wind waits a long time, and then gives up. The field's dead walk behind you a while, like an honour guard.
